info.title: Sagara.NuGetDiff.Tool
info.description: Builds a ready-to-run git commit command listing the NuGet packages upgraded, downgraded, added, and removed in Directory.Packages.props, and copies it to the clipboard.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Builds a git commit command listing the NuGet packages upgraded, downgraded, added, and removed in Directory.Packages.props, and copies it to the clipboard.

options.name: --file
options.description: The Directory.Packages.props file to compare. Defaults to the nearest one at or above the current directory.

options.name: --from
options.description: The revision to compare from. [default: HEAD]

options.name: --to
options.description: Compare to this revision instead of the working tree.

options.name: --staged
options.description: Compare to the staged file instead of the working tree. [default: False]

options.name: --subject
options.description: The first line of the commit message. [default: Update NuGet packages]

options.name: --shell
options.description: The shell to quote the git command for. [default: Posix]

options.name: --no-clipboard
options.description: Print the git command without copying it to the clipboard. [default: False]
